title: Behind the shutter
description: A near-black shutter snaps horizontally across a still photograph, concealing a scene change during a brief fully covered interval.
useCase: Give a photographic scene change spatial continuity through an opaque foreground object.
interaction: Advance the architectural study. Another press queues one extra crossing; pause freezes the current frame.
reducedMotion: Pressing the next control switches scenes immediately. Keyboard actions also skip the traversal. Host pause freezes elapsed time and resumes from that point.
limitations: Two local photographs and an independently authored CSS shutter. This is a directed photographic transition, not extracted depth geometry or a physically simulated camera.
look: Full-bleed concrete architecture with one restrained serif scene title. A near-black mechanical curtain with restrained seams passes horizontally across the photograph.
motion: Two fast horizontal strokes share 220 ms of travel with a 40 ms covered hold by default. The photograph remains still and changes only under full coverage. At most one extra advance is queued; host pause and document hiding freeze the cycle.
adapt: Replace `SCENES` with local photographs. `Take` snapshots the timing and direction per crossing. `crossingMs`, `occluderWidth`, `coveredHoldMs` and `direction` affect the next advance; keep the full-coverage swap invariant in `tick`.
